summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Saved watchlists not persisting  ### What I found from a read-only audit (no changes made)  I traced the full path: `WatchlistPage.tsx` → `client/src/lib/api.ts` → `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts` → `watchlists`/`watchlist_items` tables, plus the auth flow in `modules/auth/handlers.ts` and `db/auth.ts`.  Contrary to the ticket's hunch, I could **not** find an obvious anonymous/local-storage fallback or a missing session check: - The DB schema correctly has `user_id` on `watchlists`, and every handler (list, get, create, update, delete, add/remove item) filters by `
